name: Notice of Adjournment
agenda_text:
NOTICE OF ADJOURNMENT
NOTICE IS HEREBY GIVEN that the June 10, 2024 regular meeting of the City
Council of the City of Artesia has been adjourned, due to lack of quorum, to 7:00
p.m. on June 17, 2024, in the City Hall Council Chambers located at 18747 Clarkdale
Avenue, Artesia, California 90701.

Dated June 10, 2024
  /s/ Jennifer Alderete, City Clerk
